summary: John's 1st cousin 10x removed; master of the Hauppauge estate; first cousin of John's 8th-great-grandfather James Smith, whose land bordered his.
bio: When the town was divided among Bull Smith's heirs, the Hauppauge land fell to Daniel 2d and his sister Deborah; he bought out her share and left it to sons Caleb and Joshua (Wood p. 25). On 10 Apr 1736 he received land 'on the right of his father Daniel Smith deceased', including 493 acres at the head of the river joining the Islip line (Pelletreau pp. 236, 248). His unexecuted will gives 'my fourth son Joshua' the Hauppauge Neck, 'south by Islip line, west by the river, north by the north east branch', 893 acres (pp. 359–363). Married Hannah Brewster (1698–1761) — hence the name Joshua Brewster Smith; whether she is of the same Brewster family as John Thompson's supposed wife is unproven. Grandfather of Sen. Gen. John Smith (via daughter Mary).
